description: Header file defining the ProofSourceChromium class implementing the quic::ProofSource interface for QUIC protocol, including methods for initialization, proof retrieval, certificate chain access, and TLS signature computation.

classes.name: ProofSourceChromium
classes.description: Implements the quic::ProofSource interface for Chromium's QUIC proof source, managing certificate and key initialization, proof generation, and TLS signature operations.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the proof source with certificate chain, private key, and optional SCT.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Generates a proof for the given server and client addresses, hostname, server config, and QUIC version.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain associated with the proof source.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature using the private key.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the ticket crypter used for session tickets.

methods.name: SetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Sets the ticket crypter for session ticket encryption.

methods.name: GetProofInner
methods.description: Internal method to generate proof details.
